title: Which Room Money the Statutory Tax Acts On during a Hotel Rate Plans Stay
content:
The room money the statutory tax acts on over a Hotel Rate Plans stay turns on how far the folio's room lines have run against the stay booked, and on where the reservation record stands.

**The nights of the stay already covered on the folio are taken as the highest night sequence the folio's room lines carry.**

## The rule

1. Where the nights of the stay already covered on the folio are fewer than the nights the reservation covers and the reservation stands at checked in, the room money the tax acts on is the room money posted as it stands, the tax following the nights already covered.
2. Where the nights already covered are fewer than the nights the reservation covers and the reservation stands at checked out, the room money the tax acts on is the room money posted grossed up in the proportion the nights the reservation covers bear to the nights already covered on the folio.
3. In every other case the room money the tax acts on is the room money posted grossed up in that same proportion.

## The combinations

| Nights already covered on the folio | Reservation record stands at | Room money the tax acts on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fewer than the nights the reservation covers | checked in | the room money posted as it stands |
| fewer than the nights the reservation covers | checked out | the room money posted grossed up in the proportion the nights covered bear to the nights already covered |
| fewer than the nights the reservation covers | any other standing | the room money posted grossed up in that same proportion |
| equal to or beyond the nights the reservation covers | any standing | the room money posted grossed up in that same proportion |

Where the nights already covered equal the nights the reservation covers, the proportion is one to one and the gross-up leaves the figure where it stands.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Room money posted of 1,200.00 USD on a reservation covering 4 nights, whose room lines carry a highest night sequence of 3:

- Standing at checked in, the room money the tax acts on is 1,200.00 USD.
- Standing at checked out, it is 1,200.00 USD grossed up in the proportion 4 bears to 3, which is 1,600.00 USD.
- Standing at any other point, it is likewise 1,600.00 USD.
